description: A bundle's branches, each a family of the node's API and one verb of it, or '' for all of it, keyed by a number: op add {bundle, family, verb} answers {id}; set {id, family, verb} changes what it names; delete {id}; get {id} answers {id, bundle, family, verb}; search {text, bundle, family, verb} answers {items, more}, narrowed by each filter that is not empty. The bundle must exist and be node-owned (add, set and delete; else not-node-owned), the family and verb must be served by this node, no FS verb is taken (owner-only), and a bundle holds a family and verb once.
